# Anvik Labs

> Anvik Labs is an independent product design and engineering studio in India. We design digital experiences, build web products, and explore practical AI solutions. Based in India, working with teams worldwide.

## What Anvik Labs does
- Designs and engineers digital products for clients.
- Builds and experiments with independent products.
- Offers product design, web development, AI solutions, and website maintenance.

## Preferred citation
- Official name: Anvik Labs
- Canonical URL: https://anviklabs.site/
- One-line description: Anvik Labs is an independent product design and engineering studio based in India, designing and building digital products and practical AI solutions for clients worldwide.
- Contact: anviklabs@gmail.com

## Key pages
- [Home](https://anviklabs.site/): Independent technology studio overview, selected work, services, team, testimonials, and FAQs.
- [Works](https://anviklabs.site/works): Selected client and independently developed digital product case studies.
- [Journal](https://anviklabs.site/journal): Notes and insights on design, engineering, and digital craft.
- [Production Readiness Architecture Audit](https://anviklabs.site/journal/production-readiness-architecture-audit): Checklist and lessons on auditing caching, pagination, security, observability, and reliability.
- [Product Design](https://anviklabs.site/services/product-design): UI/UX design, product flows, design systems, and prototypes.
- [Development](https://anviklabs.site/services/development): Business websites, web applications, dashboards, internal tools, backend APIs and practical AI integrations for startups and small businesses.
- [AI Solutions](https://anviklabs.site/services/ai-solutions): Practical AI integrations, LLM workflows, and chat experiences.
- [Website Maintenance](https://anviklabs.site/services/website-maintenance): Ongoing updates, performance, fixes, and support.
- [Contact](https://anviklabs.site/contact): Start a project conversation with Anvik Labs.

## Development service
- Canonical URL: https://anviklabs.site/services/development
- Scope: business websites, portfolios, landing pages, web applications, dashboards, customer portals, internal tools, admin panels, backend APIs, authentication, databases and third-party integrations.
- Process: discuss requirements, agree written scope/timeline/cost, build in stages, test and launch, then support and improve.
- Stack: React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL and modern AI frameworks and APIs, chosen per project.
- Team: a small hands-on team based in India, working with clients worldwide. Clients work directly with the people building the project.
- AI work: chatbots, LLM integrations, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems and AI features connected to existing applications.
- Support: bug fixes, updates, performance improvements, migrations and ongoing maintenance after launch.
